学生.pinyin: Wǒ shì niú jīn dà xué de xué sheng
学生.en: I am a student at Oxford University.
学生.es: Soy estudiante de la universidad de Oxford.

学生.pinyin: Wǒ men bān yǒu sì shí gè xué sheng
学生.en: There are forty students in our class.
学生.es: Hay cuarenta estudiantes en nuestra clase.

学生.zh: 爱迪生不是个优秀的学生。
学生.pinyin: Ài dí shēng bù shì gè yōu xiù de xué sheng
学生.en: Edison was not a bright student.
学生.es: Edison no fue un estudiante brillante.

学生.zh: 这个学校的学生很友好。
学生.pinyin: Zhè ge xué xiào de xué sheng hěn yǒu hǎo
学生.en: The students of this school are kind.
学生.es: Los estudiantes de este colegio son amables.

两.pinyin: Wǒ rèn shi tā liǎng nián le
两.en: I have known her for two years.
两.es: Hace dos años que le conozco.

两.pinyin: Wǒ dì di méi wǒ liǎng nián qián gāo
两.en: My brother is not as tall as I was two years ago.
两.es: Mi hermano no es tan alto como lo era yo hace dos años.

两.zh: 我有两个儿子，一个在东京，另一个在名古屋。
两.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu liǎng gèr zi yī ge zài dōng jīng lìng yī gè zài míng gǔ wū
两.en: I have two sons; one is in Tokyo, and the other in Nagoya.
两.es: Tengo dos hijos: uno está en Tokio y el otro en Nagoya.

两.zh: 我用两千日元买了这本书。
两.pinyin: Wǒ yòng liǎng qiān rì yuán mǎi le zhè běn shū
两.en: I paid two thousand yen for the book.
两.es: Compré el libro por doscientos yenes.

但是.pinyin: Dàn shì wǒ méi yǒu qián

但是.zh: 但是，在「真实的大人世界」里是有很多竞争的。
但是.pinyin: Dàn shì zài zhēn shí de dà ren shì jiè lǐ shì yǒu hěn duō jìng zhēng de
但是.en: And yet, in the "real adult world" there are a lot of competitions.
但是.es: Sin embargo, en el "mundo de los adultos" hay mucha competencia.

但是.zh: 他不是歌手，但是个演员。
但是.pinyin: Tā bù shì gē shǒu dàn shì gè yǎn yuán
但是.en: He is not a singer, but an actor.

但是.pinyin: Dàn shì tā bù cháng wēi xiào
但是.en: But he did not often smile.
但是.es: Pero él no sonríe con frecuencia.

上班.zh: 除了雨天，我都是骑车去上班的。
上班.pinyin: Chú le yǔ tiān wǒ dōu shì qí chē qù shàng bān de
上班.en: I go to the office by bicycle except on rainy days.
上班.es: Voy en bicicleta a la oficina salvo los días de lluvia.

上班.zh: 我爸爸不是每天都走路上班的。
上班.pinyin: Wǒ bà ba bù shì měi tiān dōu zǒu lù shàng bān de
上班.en: My father does not always walk to work.
上班.es: Mi padre no va siempre andando al trabajo.

上班.pinyin: Nǐ shàng bān chí dào le

上班.zh: 我会在七月一号开始上班。
上班.pinyin: Wǒ huì zài qī yuè yī hào kāi shǐ shàng bān
上班.en: I will start working on July first.
上班.es: Empiezo a trabajar el uno de julio.

面条.pinyin: Nǐ chī miàn tiáo hái shi chī fàn
面条.en: Do you want to eat noodles or rice?

面条.zh: 你要吃面条还是吃米饭？
面条.pinyin: Nǐ yào chī miàn tiáo hái shi chī mǐ fàn
面条.en: Do you want to eat noodles or rice?

面条.zh: 你吃面条还是吃饭？喝橙汁还是喝咖啡？
面条.pinyin: Nǐ chī miàn tiáo hái shi chī fàn hē chéng zhī hái shi hē kā fēi
面条.en: Do you want to eat noodles or rice? Do you want to drink fruit juice or coffee?
面条.es: ¿Quieres comer fideos o arroz? ¿Quieres tomar zumo de frutas o café?

终于.zh: 我们终于达到了我们的目标。
终于.pinyin: Wǒ men zhōng yú dá dào le wǒ men de mù biāo
终于.en: At last, we reached our destination.
终于.es: Por fin llegamos a nuestro destino.

终于.pinyin: Tā zhōng yú qù měi guó le
终于.en: At last, he went to America.
终于.es: Por fin, se fue a América.

终于.pinyin: Tā zhōng yú shuì zháo le
Zhōng yú kāi shǐ xià yǔ le
终于.en: At last, it began to rain.

月亮.zh: 我们看不到月亮的另一边。
月亮.pinyin: Wǒ men kàn bù dào yuè liang de lìng yī biān
月亮.en: We cannot see the other side of the moon.
月亮.es: No podemos ver el otro lado de la Luna.

月亮.zh: 在云的遮蔽下无法见到月亮。
月亮.pinyin: Zài yún de zhē bì xià wú fǎ jiàn dào yuè liang
月亮.en: The moon is invisible behind the clouds.
月亮.es: La luna es invisible detrás de las nubes.

月亮.pinyin: Yuè liang yǐ jīng chū lái le
Yuè liang bèi yún zhē zhù le
月亮.en: The moon is behind the clouds.
月亮.es: La luna está detrás de las nubes.

警察.pinyin: Yǒu gè jǐng chá zǒu le guò lái
警察.en: A policeman came up to me.

警察.zh: 他超速驾驶，被警察逮捕了。
警察.pinyin: Tā chāo sù jià shǐ bèi jǐng chá dài bǔ le
警察.en: The policeman arrested him for speeding.
警察.es: El policía le arrestó por sobrepasar la velocidad.

警察.zh: 警察大概从一个月前就开始找被偷物品了。
警察.pinyin: Jǐng chá dà gài cóng yī ge yuè qián jiù kāi shǐ zhǎo bèi tōu wù pǐn le
警察.en: The police have been searching for the stolen goods for almost a month.
警察.es: La Policía lleva casi un mes buscando los bienes robados.

答案.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng nǐ de dá àn shì duì de
答案.en: I think your answer is correct.
答案.es: Creo que tu respuesta es correcta.

答案.pinyin: Wǒ de dá àn duì bù duì

答案.zh: 严格地说，他的答案并不对。
答案.pinyin: Yán gé de shuō tā de dá àn bìng bù duì
答案.en: Strictly speaking, his answer is not correct.
答案.es: En sentido estricto, su respuesta es incorrecta.

答案.zh: 你真的需要提问题来知道答案吗？
答案.pinyin: Nǐ zhēn de xū yào tí wèn tí lái zhī dào dá àn ma
答案.en: Do you really need to ask the question to know the answer?
答案.es: ¿Realmente necesitas preguntar para saber la respuesta?

汤.pinyin: Chèn rè hē nǐ de tāng
汤.en: Eat your soup while it is hot.
汤.es: Cómete la sopa mientras esté caliente.

汤.pinyin: Pián yi de ròu zuò bù chū hǎo tāng
汤.en: Cheap meat doesn't make good soup.
汤.es: No puedes hacer buena sopa con carne barata.

汤.pinyin: Zhè tāng lǐ yán fàng duō le
汤.en: There's too much salt in this soup.

汤.pinyin: Zhè wǎn tāng dà xián le hē bù xià
汤.en: This soup is too salty to eat.
汤.es: Esta sopa está demasiado salada para comerse.

尊重.zh: 他的英勇行为使他赢得了尊重。
尊重.pinyin: Tā de yīng yǒng xíng wéi shǐ tā yíng dé le zūn zhòng
尊重.en: His brave deed earned him respect.
尊重.es: Su valiente hazaña le otorgó el respeto.

尊重.zh: 英国人很尊重法序和秩序。
尊重.pinyin: Yīng guó rén hěn zūn zhòng fǎ xù hé zhì xù
尊重.en: The British have a lot of respect for law and order.
尊重.es: Los británicos tienen mucho respeto a la ley y al orden.

尊重.pinyin: Liǎo jiě tā de rén dōu zūn zhòng tā
尊重.en: Whoever knows him well respects him.

尊重.zh: 我的父母告诉我, 必须尊重老年人。
尊重.pinyin: Wǒ de fù mǔ gào su wǒ bì xū zūn zhòng lǎo nián rén
尊重.en: My parents told me that I need to respect old people.

交.pinyin: Wǒ men hé jiǎn jiāo le péng you

交.zh: 这个月底前，我们必须交报告。
交.pinyin: Zhè ge yuè dǐ qián wǒ men bì xū jiāo bào gào
交.en: We have to turn in our reports by the end of this month.
交.es: Tenemos que entregar nuestros informes antes de final de mes.

交.zh: 你几岁交了第一个女朋友？
交.pinyin: Nǐ jǐ suì jiāo le dì yī gè nǚ péng you
交.en: At what age did you have your first girlfriend?
交.es: ¿A qué edad tuviste tu primera novia?

交.zh: 今天是交学费的最后一天，我银行卡里没钱了。
交.pinyin: Jīn tiān shì jiāo xué fèi de zuì hòu yī tiān wǒ yín háng kǎ lǐ méi qián le
交.en: Today is the last day to pay tuition fees, and my credit card has no money on it.

家具.pinyin: Wǒ men yǒu hěn duō jiā jù
家具.en: We had a lot of furniture.

家具.zh: 所有的家具都布满了灰尘。
家具.pinyin: Suǒ yǒu de jiā jù dōu bù mǎn le huī chén
家具.en: All the furniture was covered with dust.
家具.es: Todos los muebles estaban llenos de polvo.

家具.pinyin: Fáng zi lǐ jiā jù tài duō le
家具.en: There is too much furniture in the house.
家具.es: En la casa hay demasiados muebles.

家具.zh: 用优质材料做的家具卖得很好。
家具.pinyin: Yòng yōu zhì cái liào zuò de jiā jù mài de hěn hǎo
家具.en: Furniture made of good materials sells well.
家具.es: Los muebles hechos con materiales buenos se venden bien.

通知.zh: 他把交通事故通知了警察。
通知.pinyin: Tā bǎ jiāo tōng shì gù tōng zhī le jǐng chá
通知.en: He notified the police of the traffic accident.
通知.es: Informó a la policía del accidente de tráfico.

通知.zh: 她来到的时候我会通知你。
通知.pinyin: Tā lái dào de shí hou wǒ huì tōng zhī nǐ
通知.en: I'll let you know when she arrives.

通知.zh: 货物运到，我会通知你们的。
通知.pinyin: Huò wù yùn dào wǒ huì tōng zhī nǐ men de
通知.en: I will notify you of the arrival of the goods.

只好.zh: 昨天太冷了，我只好待在家里。
只好.pinyin: Zuó tiān tài lěng le wǒ zhǐ hǎo dāi zài jiā lǐ
只好.en: It was so cold yesterday that I stayed home.
只好.es: Hacía tanto frío ayer que me quedé en casa.

只好.zh: 为了保护自己，我们只好说谎。
只好.pinyin: Wèi le bǎo hù zì jǐ wǒ men zhǐ hǎo shuō huǎng
只好.en: To defend ourselves, we had to tell a lie.

只好.zh: 我的朋友全都喝得酩酊大醉，我只好开车把他们送回家。
只好.pinyin: Wǒ de péng you quán dōu hē de mǐng dǐng dà zuì wǒ zhǐ hǎo kāi chē bǎ tā men sòng huí jiā
只好.en: My friends were so boozed up that I had to drive them home.
只好.es: Mis amigos estaban tan borrachos que tuve que llevarlos a su casa.

只好.zh: 为了避开警方的追捕，狄马只好在垃圾箱里过了一晚。
只好.pinyin: Wèi le bì kāi jǐng fāng de zhuī bǔ dí mǎ zhǐ hǎo zài lā jī xiāng lǐ guo le yī wǎn
只好.en: Hiding from the police, Dima spent the night in a dumpster.
只好.es: Para esconderse de la policía, Dima pasó la noche en un contenedor.

难道.zh: 你们要是用刀剑刺向我们，我们难道不会流血吗？
难道.pinyin: Nǐ men yào shi yòng dāo jiàn cì xiàng wǒ men wǒ men nán dào bù huì liú xuè ma
难道.en: If you prick us, do we not bleed?

难道.zh: 难道他可以买一把刀，而我就不行了？
难道.pinyin: Nán dào tā kě yǐ mǎi yī bǎ dāo ér wǒ jiù bù xíng le
难道.en: If it's okay for him to buy a knife, then why on earth can't I?
难道.es: Si está bien si él se compra un cuchillo, ¿por qué cielos no puedo?

难道.zh: 你每天都是做一模一样的东西，难道不会觉得闷吗？
难道.pinyin: Nǐ měi tiān dōu shì zuò yī mú yī yàng de dōng xi nán dào bù huì jué de mēn ma
难道.en: I wonder if you don't get tired of doing the same thing every day.
难道.es: Me extraña que no te canses de hacer la misma cosa todos los días.

难道.pinyin: Nán dào bù shì zhè yàng ma

学期.zh: 我这个学期的成绩很差。
学期.pinyin: Wǒ zhè ge xué qī de chéng jì hěn chà
学期.en: I got terrible grades this term.

学期.zh: 我自学了半个学期的德文。
学期.pinyin: Wǒ zì xué le bàn ge xué qī de dé wén
学期.en: I have self-studied half a semester's worth of German.
学期.es: Aprendí alemán por medio de un curso de autoaprendizaje.

学期.zh: 在学期的第一天，他买了写作业要用到的教科书。
学期.pinyin: Zài xué qī de dì yī tiān tā mǎi le xiě zuò yè yào yòng dào de jiào kē shū
学期.en: The first day of the course he bought the textbook which he needed to do his homework.
学期.es: El primer día del curso él compró el libro de texto el cual necesitaba para hacer sus deberes.

学期.zh: 这个学期我们有两次考试。
学期.pinyin: Zhè ge xué qī wǒ men yǒu liǎng cì kǎo shì
学期.en: We have two examinations during this term.

商量.pinyin: Wǒ de zhǎo rén shāng liang yī xià
商量.en: I need to find someone to discuss this with.

商量.zh: 有件事我一直想跟你商量。
商量.pinyin: Yǒu jiàn shì wǒ yī zhí xiǎng gēn nǐ shāng liang
商量.en: There's something I've been meaning to discuss with you.

商量.zh: 我不知道该和谁商量好。
商量.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhī dào gāi hé shéi shāng liang hǎo
商量.en: I don't know who to consult with.

商量.pinyin: Tā xiǎng yǔ tā shāng liang yī xiē shì
商量.en: She wanted to go over a few things with him.

塑料袋.zh: 不，谢谢。我不需要塑料袋。
塑料袋.pinyin: Bù xiè xie wǒ bù xū yào sù liào dài
塑料袋.en: No thank you, I don't need a plastic bag.
塑料袋.es: No, gracias. No necesito un saco de plástico.

塑料袋.zh: 不用，谢谢。不需要塑料袋。
塑料袋.pinyin: Bù yòng xiè xie bù xū yào sù liào dài
塑料袋.en: No thank you, I don't need a plastic bag.
塑料袋.es: No, gracias. No necesito un saco de plástico.

塑料袋.pinyin: Wǒ jù jué shǐ yòng sù liào dài
塑料袋.en: I refuse to use plastic bags.

秘密.pinyin: Tā tòu lù le wǒ de mì mì

秘密.zh: 他把她的秘密告诉了他的朋友。
秘密.pinyin: Tā bǎ tā de mì mì gào su le tā de péng you
秘密.en: He betrayed her secret to his friends.
秘密.es: Les dijo el secreto a sus amigos.

秘密.zh: 他说得好像知道这个秘密一样。
秘密.pinyin: Tā shuō de hǎo xiàng zhī dào zhè ge mì mì yī yàng
秘密.en: He talks as if he knew the secret.
秘密.es: Él habla como si supiera el secreto.

蔬菜.zh: 这里有个装满蔬菜的篮子。
蔬菜.pinyin: Zhè lǐ yǒu gè zhuāng mǎn shū cài de lán zi
蔬菜.en: Here is a basket full of vegetables.
蔬菜.es: Aquí hay una canasta llena de verduras.

蔬菜.pinyin: Wèi shén me nǐ bù chī shū cài
Shū cài de jià gé měi tiān zài biàn
蔬菜.en: The price of vegetables varies from day to day.
蔬菜.es: El precio de los vegetales cambia diariamente.

蔬菜.zh: 这种蔬菜英语叫甚么名字？
蔬菜.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shū cài yīng yǔ jiào shèn má míng zi
蔬菜.en: What do you call this vegetable in English?
蔬菜.es: ¿Cómo se llama esta verdura en inglés?

导致.zh: 一点点的运气有时会导致意想不到的成功。
导致.pinyin: Yī diǎn diǎn de yùn qi yǒu shí huì dǎo zhì yì xiǎng bù dào de chéng gōng
导致.en: A little bit of luck sometimes leads to an unexpected success.
导致.es: Una pizca de suerte a veces lleva a eventos inesperados.

导致.zh: 酗酒是导致阳痿的一个因素。
导致.pinyin: Xù jiǔ shì dǎo zhì yáng wěi de yī ge yīn sù
导致.en: Excessive drinking is one of the causes of impotence.
导致.es: El exceso de bebida es una de las causas de impotencia.

导致.pinyin: Zhè yàng de xíng wéi dǎo zhì wèn tí
导致.en: Such behavior gives rise to problems.
导致.es: Ese comportamiento solo aumentará el problema.

导致.zh: 粗心大意可能导致严重的事故。
导致.pinyin: Cū xīn dà yì kě néng dǎo zhì yán zhòng de shì gù
导致.en: Carelessness can lead to a serious accident.
导致.es: La falta de atención puede conducir a un serio accidente.

群.zh: 我们被一大群蜜蜂攻击。
群.pinyin: Wǒ men bèi yī dà qún mì fēng gōng jī
群.en: We were attacked by swarms of bees.
群.es: Fuimos atacados por enjambres de abejas.

群.zh: 在那滩冰淇淋的周围，有一群蚂蚁在爬来爬去。
群.pinyin: Zài nà tān bīng qí lín de zhōu wéi yǒu yī qún mǎ yǐ zài pá lái pá qù
群.en: The area around the melting ice cream was crawling with ants.
群.es: El área alrededor del helado que se derretía estaba plagada de hormigas.

群.zh: 牛群在郁郁葱葱的草地上缓缓移动著。
群.pinyin: Niú qún zài yù yù cōng cōng de cǎo dì shàng huǎn huǎn yí dòng zhe
群.en: The cows were moving very slowly through the long green grass.
群.es: Las vacas se movían muy lentamente a través del largo pasto verde.

表达.zh: 我不知道如何表达我的谢意。
表达.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhī dào rú hé biǎo dá wǒ de xiè yì
表达.en: I don't know how to express my thanks.
表达.es: No sé cómo demostrar mi agradecimiento.

表达.zh: 我觉得很难用言语表达我的意思。
表达.pinyin: Wǒ jué de hěn nán yòng yán yǔ biǎo dá wǒ de yì si
表达.en: I find it difficult to express my meaning in words.
表达.es: Me resulta difícil expresar en palabras lo que quiero decir.

表达.zh: 这份职位要求应征者有一定的英语口语表达能力。
表达.pinyin: Zhè fèn zhí wèi yāo qiú yìng zhēng zhě yǒu yī dìng de yīng yǔ kǒu yǔ biǎo dá néng lì
表达.en: The position requires applicants to be skilled in spoken English.
表达.es: El puesto requiere que los postulantes sean hábiles en el inglés hablado.

表达.zh: 内心世界很丰富，不知该如何表达了！
表达.pinyin: Nèi xīn shì jiè hěn fēng fù bù zhī gāi rú hé biǎo dá le
表达.en: Deep down, everyone is rich and beautiful, but we don't know how to express it!
表达.es: Mi mundo interior es muy amplio. ¡No sé cómo expresarlo!

秘书.pinyin: Tā jiào mǎ lì shì wǒ de mì shū
秘书.en: Her name is Mary, she is my secretary.
秘书.es: Ella se llama Mari, es mi secretaria.

秘书.pinyin: Tā zài chāo shì zuò mì shū
秘书.en: She is a clerk in the supermarket.
秘书.es: Ella es una empleada en el supermercado.

挤.pinyin: Wǒ bù xǐ huan zuò nà ge zǒng shì jǐ niú nǎi de rén
挤.en: I don't like being the one who always has to milk the cow.

挤.zh: 火车挤得要命，我们都找不到位子坐。
挤.pinyin: Huǒ chē jǐ děi yào mìng wǒ men dōu zhǎo bu dào wèi zi zuò
挤.en: The train was so crowded that none of us could get a seat.

走出.zh: 在雨中走出去是不可能的。
走出.pinyin: Zài yǔ zhōng zǒu chū qù shì bù kě néng de
走出.en: Going out in this rain is out of the question.
走出.es: Ni pensar en salir en esta lluvia.

走出.pinyin: Tā zǒu chū le fáng jiān
走出.en: He walked out of the room.

走出.pinyin: Tā hěn kuài de zǒu chū le fáng jiān
走出.en: He quickly went out of the room.

走出.pinyin: Tā zǒu chū le fáng jiān
走出.en: She went out of the room.

脚步.zh: 她在镜前停下脚步，自我欣赏了一番。
脚步.pinyin: Tā zài jìng qián tíng xià jiǎo bù zì wǒ xīn shǎng le yī fān
脚步.en: She stopped before the mirror to admire herself.
脚步.es: Se paró frente al espejo para admirarse a sí misma.

脚步.zh: 汤姆想追随他父亲的脚步。
脚步.pinyin: Tāng mǔ xiǎng zhuī suí tā fù qīn de jiǎo bù
脚步.en: Tom wanted to follow in his father's footsteps.
脚步.es: Tom quería seguir los pasos de su padre.

脚步.pinyin: Tā de jiǎo bù màn xià lai le
Tū rán wǒ tíng xià jiǎo bù

五月.pinyin: Wǒ shì bu shì wǔ yuè chū shēng de
五月.en: Was it in May that I was born?

五月.zh: 我出生在墨西哥美丽的五月
五月.pinyin: Wǒ chū shēng zài mò xī gē měi lì de wǔ yuè
五月.en: I was born in Mexico on a beautiful day in May.
五月.es: Nací en México un bonito mes de mayo.

五月.pinyin: Tā men wǔ yuè chū dào le dà bǎn
五月.en: They arrived in Osaka at the beginning of May.
五月.es: Ellos llegaron a Osaka a comienzos de mayo.

五月.zh: 所有月份中我最喜欢五月。
五月.pinyin: Suǒ yǒu yuè fèn zhōng wǒ zuì xǐ huan wǔ yuè
五月.en: I like May the best of all the months.
五月.es: De todos los meses mayo es el que más me gusta.

高度.zh: 你半透明的裙子让我高度兴奋。
高度.pinyin: Nǐ bàn tòu míng de qún zi ràng wǒ gāo dù xīng fèn
高度.en: I am completely agog over your diaphanous dress.
高度.es: Tu vestido transparente realmente me excita.

高度.zh: 世界上任何山峰都达不到珠穆朗玛峰的高度。
高度.pinyin: Shì jiè shàng rèn hé shān fēng dōu dá bù dào zhū mù lǎng mǎ fēng de gāo dù
高度.en: No other mountain in the world is as tall as Mt. Everest.
高度.es: No hay en el mundo ninguna montaña tan alta como el Everest.

高度.zh: 这是一个高度发展的文明。
高度.pinyin: Zhè shì yī ge gāo dù fā zhǎn de wén míng
高度.en: This is a highly developed civilisation.

高度.zh: 洪水涌到了窗户的高度。
高度.pinyin: Hóng shuǐ chōng dào le chuāng hu de gāo dù
高度.en: The flood water reached the level of the windows.

同桌.zh: 我们和同桌比赛看谁背书快，结果我输了。
同桌.pinyin: Wǒ men hé tóng zhuō bǐ sài kàn shéi bèi shū kuài jié guǒ wǒ shū le
同桌.en: We raced against our deskmate to see who could memorize the text faster, and I lost.

多工.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu hěn duō gōng zuō yào zuò
多工.en: I have a lot of work to do.

多工.zh: 有很多工人被困在煤矿里了。
多工.pinyin: Yǒu hěn duō gōng rén bèi kùn zài méi kuàng lǐ le
多工.en: Many workers were trapped in the coal mine.
多工.es: Muchos trabajadores quedaron atrapados en la mina de carbón.

多工.zh: 我们还有很多工作要做。
多工.pinyin: Wǒ men hái yǒu hěn duō gōng zuō yào zuò
多工.en: We still have a lot more work to do.

玛丽娅.zh: 玛丽娅拿了一个鸡蛋，并将它在碗沿上敲开。
玛丽娅.pinyin: Mǎ lì yà ná le yī ge jī dàn bìng jiāng tā zài wǎn yán shàng qiāo kāi
玛丽娅.en: Mary took an egg and cracked it open on the rim of the bowl.
玛丽娅.es: María cogió un huevo y lo rompió contra en borde del cuenco.

玛丽娅.pinyin: Mǎ lì yà bào zhe yī ge xī guā
Mǎ lì yà bù dú yīng yǔ shū
玛丽娅.en: Maria does not read English books.
玛丽娅.es: María no lee libros en inglés.

玛丽娅.zh: 玛丽娅花很多钱买衣服。
玛丽娅.pinyin: Mǎ lì yà huā hěn duō qián mǎi yī fu
玛丽娅.en: Maria spends a lot of money on clothes.
玛丽娅.es: María se gasta mucho dinero en ropa.

茄子.pinyin: Qié zi hú luó bo xī hóng shì

茄子.zh: 姐姐在市场买了一点茄子、土豆、丝瓜和大白菜。
茄子.pinyin: Jiě jie zài shì chǎng mǎi le yī diǎn qié zi tǔ dòu sī guā hé dà bái cài
茄子.en: Our sister bought some eggplants, potatoes, zucchinis and Chinese cabbage at the market.

酸奶.zh: 你喜欢什么牌子的酸奶？
酸奶.pinyin: Nǐ xǐ huan shén me pái zi de suān nǎi
酸奶.en: What's your favorite brand of yogurt?
酸奶.es: ¿Cuál es tu marca de yogur favorita?

酸奶.zh: 这个酸奶是什么口味的？
酸奶.pinyin: Zhè ge suān nǎi shì shén me kǒu wèi de
酸奶.en: What flavour does this yoghurt have?

酸奶.zh: 她喜欢吃草莓味的酸奶。
酸奶.pinyin: Tā xǐ huan chī cǎo méi wèi de suān nǎi
酸奶.en: She likes to drink strawberry-flavored yogurt.

酸奶.pinyin: Nǐ zuì xǐ huan nǎ yī zhǒng suān nǎi
酸奶.en: What sort of yogurt do you like best?

下定决心.pinyin: Wǒ hái méi yǒu xià dìng jué xīn
下定决心.en: I haven't made up my mind yet.

下定决心.pinyin: Tā xià dìng jué xīn yào chū guó le
下定决心.en: He was determined to go abroad.
下定决心.es: Él estaba decidido a ir al extranjero.

下定决心.zh: 她下定决心要拥有自己的店。
下定决心.pinyin: Tā xià dìng jué xīn yào yōng yǒu zì jǐ de diàn
下定决心.en: She is firmly determined to own a store of her own.

下定决心.zh: 我下定决心要在三年之内达成目标。
下定决心.pinyin: Wǒ xià dìng jué xīn yào zài sān nián zhī nèi dá chéng mù biāo
下定决心.en: I have made up my mind to achieve my goals in three years.

新建.zh: 新建的隧道比以前的那一条长两倍。
新建.pinyin: Xīn jiàn de suì dào bǐ yǐ qián de nà yī tiáo cháng liǎng bèi
新建.en: The new tunnel is twice as long as the old one.
新建.es: El nuevo túnel es el doble de largo que el viejo.

新建.zh: 这里现在有了许多新建筑。
新建.pinyin: Zhè lǐ xiàn zài yǒu le xǔ duō xīn jiàn zhù
新建.en: There are a lot of new buildings here now.

新建.zh: 你到底为什么把你新建的房子卖了？
新建.pinyin: Nǐ dào dǐ wèi shén me bǎ nǐ xīn jiàn de fáng zi mài le
新建.en: Why on earth did you sell your newly-built house?

新建.zh: 到处都是新建造的楼房。
新建.pinyin: Dào chù dōu shì xīn jiàn zào de lóu fáng
新建.en: New buildings are being built here, there and everywhere.

胆小.pinyin: Lái zhèng míng nǐ bù dǎn xiǎo
胆小.es: Demuestra que no eres un gallina.

胆小.zh: 鲍伯非常胆小，和女生聊天时会脸红。
胆小.pinyin: Bào bǎi fēi cháng dǎn xiǎo hé nǚ shēng liáo tiān shí huì liǎn hóng
胆小.en: Bob is very timid and blushes when chatting with girls.
胆小.es: Bob es muy tímido y se ruboriza cuando habla con chicas.

胆小.pinyin: Tā shì gè dǎn xiǎo pà shì de rén
Lǎo shǔ shì dǎn xiǎo de shēng wù
胆小.en: A mouse is a timid creature.

葬礼.zh: 我一定会去参加你的葬礼的。
葬礼.pinyin: Wǒ yī dìng huì qù cān jiā nǐ de zàng lǐ de
葬礼.en: I will definitely attend your funeral.
葬礼.es: Yo definitivamente asistiré a tu funeral.

葬礼.zh: 很多人都参加了他的葬礼。
葬礼.pinyin: Hěn duō rén dōu cān jiā le tā de zàng lǐ
葬礼.es: Un montón de gente asistió a su funeral.

葬礼.zh: 我因为没有参加他的葬礼而感到很糟糕。
葬礼.pinyin: Wǒ yīn wèi méi yǒu cān jiā tā de zàng lǐ ér gǎn dào hěn zāo gāo
葬礼.en: I feel bad about not having gone to his funeral.
葬礼.es: Me siento mal por no haber ido a su funeral.

葬礼.zh: 汤姆的葬礼订在这周末。
葬礼.pinyin: Tāng mǔ de zàng lǐ dìng zài zhè zhōu mò
葬礼.en: Tom's funeral will be this weekend.
葬礼.es: El funeral de Tom será este fin de semana.

乘车.zh: 这就是我叫你别乘车去的原因。
乘车.pinyin: Zhè jiù shì wǒ jiào nǐ bié chéng chē qù de yuán yīn
乘车.en: That's why I told you not to go by car.
乘车.es: Por eso te dije que no vayas en auto.

乘车.pinyin: Wǒ chéng chē qù xué xiào
乘车.en: I go to school by bus.
乘车.es: Voy a la escuela en colectivo.

乘车.pinyin: Wǒ chéng chē qù le hǎi biān
乘车.en: I've been to the seaside by car.

乘车.pinyin: Wǒ men chéng chē qù yǐ miǎn chí dào
乘车.en: So as to avoid being late, we went by car.

书房.zh: 妈妈，为什么爸爸不把他的书房打扫乾净？
书房.pinyin: Mā ma wèi shén me bà ba bù bǎ tā de shū fáng dǎ sǎo gān jìng
书房.en: Mum, why doesn't Dad clean his own study?
书房.es: Mamá, ¿Por qué no limpia papá su estudio?

书房.pinyin: Tā de shū fáng yǒu shù bǎi běn shū
书房.en: There are hundreds of books in his study.

付账.pinyin: Nǐ běn lái bù yīng gāi fù zhàng de
付账.en: You shouldn't have paid the bill.
付账.es: No deberías haber pagado la cuenta.

付账.pinyin: Tā yòng xìn yòng kǎ fù zhàng
付账.en: He pays with a credit card.
付账.es: Él paga con una tarjeta de crédito.

付账.zh: 幸运的是他有足够的钱来付账。
付账.pinyin: Xìng yùn de shì tā yǒu zú gòu de qián lái fù zhàng
付账.en: Luckily he had enough money to pay the bill.

勤.pinyin: Wǒ xī wàng tā lái xìn gèng qín xiē
勤.en: I wish he would write more often.
勤.es: Ojalá él me escribiese más seguido.

勤.zh: 虽然在钢琴上她的造诣不是很深，但是她勤而好学。
勤.pinyin: Suī rán zài gāng qín shàng tā de zào yì bù shì hěn shēn dàn shì tā qín ér hǎo xué
勤.en: Her repertoire on the piano is not very large, but she has learned every piece by heart.

市民.pinyin: Wǒ shì zhá huǎng de shì mín
市民.en: I am a citizen of Sapporo.

市民.zh: 学校的樱花开的烂漫，吸引了大量市民前来观赏。
市民.pinyin: Xué xiào de yīng huā kāi de làn màn xī yǐn le dà liàng shì mín qián lái guān shǎng
市民.en: The school's lovely cherry blossoms drew a lot of residents to come and admire it.
市民.es: Los coloridos cerezos en flor de la escuela atrajeron una gran cantidad de visitantes.

市民.zh: 成千上万的士兵和市民死去了。
市民.pinyin: Chéng qiān shàng wàn dī shì bīng hé shì mín sǐ qù le
市民.en: Thousands upon thousands of soldiers and civilians died.

难关.pinyin: Wǒ men yào dù guò nán guān
难关.en: We have to get through this.

难关.zh: 帮助他人度过难关的人，却无法度过自己的难关。
难关.pinyin: Bāng zhù tā rén dù guò nán guān de rén què wú fǎ dù guò zì jǐ de nán guān
难关.en: Those who help others through hard times often can't get through their own.

一排.zh: 一个美丽的女人坐在我前面一排。
一排.pinyin: Yī ge měi lì de nǚ rén zuò zài wǒ qián miàn yī pái
一排.en: A beautiful woman was seated one row in front of me.
一排.es: Una hermosa mujer estaba sentada una fila delante de mí.

一排.zh: 有一排蚂蚁在厨房里进进出出。
一排.pinyin: Yǒu yī pái mǎ yǐ zài chú fáng lǐ jìn jìn chū chū
一排.en: There's a row of ants coming in and out of the kitchen.
一排.es: Hay una corrida de hormigas entrando y saliendo de la cocina.

一排.zh: 旁边一排衣服跟这里的衣服没什么不一样。
一排.pinyin: Páng biān yī pái yī fu gēn zhè lǐ de yī fu méi shén me bù yī yàng
一排.en: There is no difference between this row of clothes and the one next to it.

一排.zh: 这里一排都是进口面料欧版的西装。
一排.pinyin: Zhè lǐ yī pái dōu shì jìn kǒu miàn liào ōu bǎn de xī zhuāng
一排.en: The suits in this row are all made of imported European fabric.

新人.zh: 典礼结束时，新人接了吻。
新人.pinyin: Diǎn lǐ jié shù shí xīn rén jiē le wěn
新人.en: At the end of the ceremony, the new couple kissed.

环境污染.zh: 环境污染可以对一个区域的生态造成极大的影响。
环境污染.pinyin: Huán jìng wū rǎn kě yǐ duì yī ge qū yù de shēng tài zào chéng jí dà de yǐng xiǎng
环境污染.en: Pollution has a disastrous effect on the ecology of a region.
环境污染.es: La polución tiene un efecto desastroso sobre la ecología de una región.

环境污染.zh: 环境污染正造成异常的天气情况。
环境污染.pinyin: Huán jìng wū rǎn zhèng zào chéng yì cháng de tiān qì qíng kuàng
环境污染.en: Environmental pollution is causing abnormal weather conditions.
环境污染.es: La contaminación ambiental está causando condiciones climáticas anormales.

环境污染.zh: 工业化常会导致环境污染。
环境污染.pinyin: Gōng yè huà cháng huì dǎo zhì huán jìng wū rǎn
环境污染.en: Industrialization often goes hand in hand with pollution.
环境污染.es: A menudo la industrialización va a la mano con la contaminación.

环境污染.zh: 我们有一节关于环境污染的讲座。
环境污染.pinyin: Wǒ men yǒu yī jié guān yú huán jìng wū rǎn de jiǎng zuò
环境污染.en: We had a lecture on environmental pollution.

警察局.pinyin: Wǒ zěn me qù jǐng chá jú
警察局.en: How can I get to the police station?

警察局.pinyin: Zuì jìn de jǐng chá jú zài nǎ lǐ
警察局.en: Where is the nearest police station?

警察局.pinyin: Zuì jìn de jǐng chá jú zài nǎ lǐ
警察局.en: Where is the nearest police station?

警察局.zh: 消防局在警察局的旁边。
警察局.pinyin: Xiāo fáng jú zài jǐng chá jú de páng biān
警察局.en: The fire station is next to the police station.
警察局.es: El parque de bomberos está al lado de la comisaria de policía.

卡洛斯.pinyin: Kǎ luò sī děng le yī huìr
Kǎ luò sī pá shàng le shān

卡洛斯.zh: 卡洛斯是一位致力於提供优质客服业务的员工。
卡洛斯.pinyin: Kǎ luò sī shì yī wèi zhì lì yú tí gōng yōu zhì kè fú yè wù de yuán gōng
卡洛斯.en: Carlos is an employee who is committed to providing excellent customer service.

卡洛斯.zh: 伊卡洛斯乘著自制的翅膀飞翔。
卡洛斯.pinyin: Yī kǎ luò sī chéng zhe zì zhì de chì bǎng fēi xiáng

尤.zh: 今天是你的生日，不是吗，尤里？
尤.pinyin: Jīn tiān shì nǐ de shēng rì bù shì ma yóu lǐ
尤.en: It's your birthday, isn't it, Yuri?

尤.pinyin: Nǐ shì bu shì yóu lì wū sī
Yóu bā yǒu diǎn kuā zhāng le
Yóu bā kàn qǐ lai hěn chéng shí

弄到.zh: 为了弄到一个好位子，我很早就出门了。
弄到.pinyin: Wèi le nòng dào yī ge hǎo wèi zi wǒ hěn zǎo jiù chū mén le
弄到.en: I left home early to get a good seat.
弄到.es: Yo salí temprano de casa para así poder coger un buen asiento.

弄到.zh: 但我们从哪儿弄到那些句子？我们又要如何翻译呢？
弄到.pinyin: Dàn wǒ men cóng nǎr nòng dào nà xiē jù zi wǒ men yòu yào rú hé fān yì ne
弄到.en: But where do we get those sentences? And how do we translate them?
弄到.es: ¿Pero de dónde sacamos estas oraciones? ¿Y cómo las traducimos?

弄到.pinyin: Gào su wǒ tā zěn me nòng dào de
弄到.en: Tell me how he got it.

弄到.zh: 我在哪儿可以弄到电话卡？
弄到.pinyin: Wǒ zài nǎr kě yǐ nòng dào diàn huà kǎ
弄到.en: Where can I get a telephone card?

激怒.pinyin: Tā bèi wǒ de huà gěi jī nù le
激怒.en: She took offence at my word.

激怒.zh: 你在会议上说的话激怒了很多人。
激怒.pinyin: Nǐ zài huì yì shàng shuō de huà jī nù le hěn duō rén
激怒.en: What you said at the meeting made a lot of people angry.

激怒.zh: 如果有人激怒你，你最好不要立刻做出反应。
激怒.pinyin: Rú guǒ yǒu rén jī nù nǐ nǐ zuì hǎo bù yào lì kè zuò chū fǎn yìng
激怒.en: If someone irritates you, it is best not to react immediately.

激怒.pinyin: Tā lì jí bèi jī nù le

贤.pinyin: Zhè shì xián zhì de yǐ zi
贤.es: Esta es la silla de Kenji.

贤.zh: 良禽择木而栖，贤臣择主而事。
贤.pinyin: Liáng qín zé mù ér qī xián chén zé zhǔ ér shì
贤.en: A prudent bird chooses its tree. A wise servant chooses his master.
贤.es: Un pájaro prudente escoge su árbol. Un sirviente sabio escoge a su amo.

贤.pinyin: Zhè xiē shū shì xián zhì de ma

赤.zh: 空手赤拳抓野兔并不容易。
赤.pinyin: Kōng shǒu chì quán zhuā yě tù bìng bù róng yì
赤.en: It is not easy to catch a hare with your bare hands.

太初.pinyin: Tài chū yǒu dào dào yǔ shén tóng zài dào jiù shì shén
太初.en: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
In the beginning was the Word.

太阳镜.zh: 汤姆把他的太阳镜留在我的车的仪表板上了。
太阳镜.pinyin: Tāng mǔ bǎ tā de tài yáng jìng liú zài wǒ de chē de yí biǎo bǎn shàng le
太阳镜.en: Tom left his sunglasses on the dashboard of my car.

太阳镜.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yī fù tài yáng jìng ér
太阳镜.en: I've got a pair of sunglasses.

姜黄.zh: 汤姆想知道哪里能买到姜黄。
姜黄.pinyin: Tāng mǔ xiǎng zhī dào nǎ lǐ néng mǎi dào jiāng huáng
姜黄.en: Tom wanted to know where he could buy turmeric.

姜黄.zh: 她从姜黄里提取美丽色彩。
姜黄.pinyin: Tā cóng jiāng huáng lǐ tí qǔ měi lì sè cǎi
姜黄.en: She extracts beautiful colors from turmeric.

婴儿车.zh: 我太太买了一台新的婴儿车。
婴儿车.pinyin: Wǒ tài tai mǎi le yī tái xīn de yīng ér chē
婴儿车.en: My wife bought a new pram.
婴儿车.es: Mi esposa compró un cochecito nuevo.

婴儿车.zh: 我看到汤姆推著婴儿车走在人行道上。
婴儿车.pinyin: Wǒ kàn dào tāng mǔ tuī zhe yīng ér chē zǒu zài rén xíng dào shàng
婴儿车.en: I saw Tom pushing a stroller down the sidewalk.

幼年.zh: 幼年时学的东西，一辈子不会忘记。
幼年.pinyin: Yòu nián shí xué de dōng xi yī bèi zi bù huì wàng jì
幼年.en: What is learned in the cradle is carried to the tomb.
幼年.es: Lo que se aprende en la cuna, se lleva a la tumba.

幼年.zh: 那是我幼年以来的梦想。
幼年.pinyin: Nà shi wǒ yòu nián yǐ lái de mèng xiǎng
幼年.en: That has been my dream since childhood.

捉迷藏.pinyin: Lái wán zhuō mí cáng ba
Zán men wánr zhuō mí cáng ba
捉迷藏.en: Let's play a game of blind man's buff.

放音.pinyin: Tā yī xǐng wǒ men jiù fàng yīn lè
放音.en: As soon as she wakes up, we'll turn on the music.
放音.es: Tan pronto esté despierta, pondremos la música.

放音.pinyin: Lǎo shī yòng lù yīn jī fàng yīn lè
放音.en: The teacher played music using a recorder.

时刻表.zh: 我可以有张公车的时刻表吗？
时刻表.pinyin: Wǒ kě yǐ yǒu zhāng gōng chē de shí kè biǎo ma
时刻表.en: May I have a bus schedule?

春暖花开.zh: 不知何时春暖花开， 今天早晨还下雪了。
春暖花开.pinyin: Bù zhī hé shí chūn nuǎn huā kāi jīn tiān zǎo chén hái xià xuě le
春暖花开.en: I don't know when spring will come and when the flowers will bloom. It was still snowing this morning.

未能.zh: 他们俩都未能找到我们的星球所面临最严重的问题。
未能.pinyin: Tā men liǎ dōu wèi néng zhǎo dào wǒ men de xīng qiú suǒ miàn lín zuì yán zhòng de wèn tí
未能.en: They have both failed to find the most serious problem that has ever faced our planet.

未能.zh: 他未能遵守交通规则，结果发生了严重的事故。
未能.pinyin: Tā wèi néng zūn shǒu jiāo tōng guī zé jié guǒ fā shēng le yán zhòng de shì gù
未能.en: His failure to observe traffic regulations resulted in a serious accident.

杰克逊.zh: 杰克逊从马背上掉了下来。
杰克逊.pinyin: Jié kè xùn cóng mǎ bèi shàng diào le xià lai
杰克逊.es: Jackson se cayó de su caballo.

杰克逊.zh: 那朵云看起来像汤姆·杰克逊。
杰克逊.pinyin: Nà duǒ yún kàn qǐ lai xiàng tāng mǔ jié kè xùn
杰克逊.en: That cloud looks like Tom Jackson.

桂花.pinyin: Tā zài huā yuán lǐ zhǒng le guì huā
桂花.en: She planted fragrant olives in the garden.

没多久.zh: 没多久，我们又碰巧遇到了。
没多久.pinyin: Méi duō jiǔ wǒ men yòu pèng qiǎo yù dào le
没多久.en: It was not long before we met again by chance.
没多久.es: No pasó mucho antes de que nos encontráramos otra vez.

甜言蜜语.zh: 一些人被甜言蜜语欺骗。
甜言蜜语.pinyin: Yī xiē rén bèi tián yán mì yǔ qī piàn
甜言蜜语.en: Some are deceived by fair words.

百米.zh: 他刷新了百米短跑的世界纪录。
百米.pinyin: Tā shuā xīn le bǎi mǐ duǎn pǎo de shì jiè jì lù
百米.en: His record is a new world record in the 100-meter dash.
百米.es: Su récord es un nuevo récord mundial en la carrera de cien metros.

百米.zh: 我刚百米冲刺，还累得不行呢。
百米.pinyin: Wǒ gāng bǎi mǐ chōng cì hái lèi de bù xíng ne
百米.en: I just did a 100-meter sprint and I'm so exhausted.

皮毛.zh: 他/她的大衣内衬是用皮毛做的。
皮毛.pinyin: Tā tā de dà yī nèi chèn shì yòng pí máo zuò de
皮毛.en: Her coat is fur on the inside.

皮毛.zh: 他对日文只是略懂皮毛。
皮毛.pinyin: Tā duì rì wén zhǐ shì lüè dǒng pí máo
皮毛.en: He has only a superficial knowledge of Japanese.

目击.pinyin: Tā mù jī le nà jiàn yì wài
Tā men bào gào mù jī le shì gù

笔墨.zh: 她的魅力难以用笔墨形容。
笔墨.pinyin: Tā de mèi lì nán yǐ yòng bǐ mò xíng róng

笔墨.zh: 那里的景色美得无法以笔墨形容。
笔墨.pinyin: Nà li de jǐng sè měi dé wú fǎ yǐ bǐ mò xíng róng
笔墨.en: The beauty of the scene was beyond description.

精髓.zh: 太可惜了，你一点也不懂它的精髓。
精髓.pinyin: Tài kě xī le nǐ yī diǎn yě bù dǒng tā de jīng suǐ
精髓.en: It's really unfortunate. You don't understand at all its essence.
精髓.es: Es realmente lamentable. Tú no comprendes en absoluto su esencia.

精髓.zh: 个人自由是民主的精髓。
精髓.pinyin: Gè rén zì yóu shì mín zhǔ de jīng suǐ
精髓.en: Individual freedom is the soul of democracy.

约瑟.pinyin: Yuē sè zhuī gǎn le mǎ lì

自保.zh: 那是我们在枪林弹雨中自保的唯一方法。
自保.pinyin: Nà shi wǒ men zài qiāng lín dàn yǔ zhōng zì bǎo de wéi yī fāng fǎ
自保.en: That was the only way we could defend ourselves against all this terrible shooting.

藤.zh: 藤村和白秋这样的诗人太少了。
藤.pinyin: Téng cūn hé bái qiū zhè yàng de shī rén tài shǎo le
藤.en: Such poets as Toson and Hakushu are rare.

蚂蚱.pinyin: Nà bù shì mà zha shì huáng chóng
蚂蚱.en: That's not a grasshopper. It's a locust!
蚂蚱.es: Eso no es un saltamontes. ¡Es un chapulín!

蚂蚱.pinyin: Nà bù shì xī shuài shì mà zha
蚂蚱.en: That's not a cricket, that's a grasshopper.
蚂蚱.es: Eso no es un grillo, eso es un saltamontes.

贬值.zh: 随着通货膨胀的发展美元贬值了。
贬值.pinyin: Suí zhe tōng huò péng zhàng de fā zhǎn měi yuán biǎn zhí le
贬值.en: The value of the dollar declines as the rate of inflation rises.
贬值.es: A medida que avanza la inflación, el valor del dólar disminuye.

铂金.zh: 小姐已经有一个戒指，要不要配一条铂金项链？
铂金.pinyin: Xiǎo jie yǐ jīng yǒu yī ge jiè zhi yào bù yào pèi yī tiáo bó jīn xiàng liàn
铂金.en: Mademoiselle, would you like a platinum necklace to accompany your ring?

三分钟热度.zh: 我的朋友总是三分钟热度，一年就换了三份工作。
三分钟热度.pinyin: Wǒ de péng you zǒng shì sān fēn zhōng rè dù yī nián jiù huàn le sān fèn gōng zuò
三分钟热度.en: My friend has had three jobs in a year; he never sticks to anything for long.

九月份.pinyin: Wǒ jiǔ yuè fèn jiù shí liù suì le
九月份.es: Voy a cumplir dieciséis en septiembre.

交加.zh: 你怕不怕雷电交加的夜晚？
交加.pinyin: Nǐ pà bù pà léi diàn jiāo jiā de yè wǎn
交加.en: Are you afraid of nights with thunder and lightning?
